scripts.frontend:start: cd frontend && bash -o pipefail -c 'ng serve --host 127.0.0.1 --poll=1000 "$@" 2>&1 | sed "/https:\/\/localhost:/d"' --
scripts.backend:dev: cd backend && bash -o pipefail -c 'node --watch src/server.js 2>&1 | sed "/^Completed running /d"'
scripts.format: npm --prefix frontend run format && npm --prefix backend run format
